title: Best Mini Fridge (2026)
summary: The guide highlights the Danby Designer Mini Fridge as the top choice for most buyers, followed by the Frigidaire Retro, Midea 3.1‑Cubic‑Foot, Igloo Single Door with Freezer, and Frigidaire 1.6‑Cubic‑Foot.
method: Picks were made by reviewing recommendations from Consumer Reports, Good Housekeeping, Family Handyman, Reviewed.com, Business Insider, and NYMag. Products mentioned by more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

products.name: Frigidaire Retro Mini Fridge
why: The Frigidaire Retro Mini Fridge earned the Best Overall award from Family Handyman. It maintains accurate temperatures, has smart storage, and includes a built‑in bottle opener and ice cube tray.
products.desc: The Frigidaire Retro Mini Fridge is a retro‑styled refrigerator that keeps accurate temperatures, offers smart storage, and includes a built‑in bottle opener and ice cube tray. It does not have a freezer compartment.
products.benefit: Picture a homeowner wanting a stylish, functional fridge for a small kitchen. The Frigidaire Retro Mini Fridge delivers accurate cooling, convenient storage, and a built‑in bottle opener, making it a practical choice over other retro models. It wins against the Danby by offering a built‑in bottle opener and ice tray. The catch: it lacks a freezer compartment.

products.name: Midea 3.1-Cubic Foot Compact Refrigerator
why: Business Insider lists the Midea 3.1‑Cubic‑Foot Compact Refrigerator as the best overall mini fridge for dorms, offices, and RVs. It offers a 3.1‑cubic‑foot capacity and adjustable shelves.
products.desc: The Midea 3.1‑Cubic Foot Compact Refrigerator is a 3.1‑cubic‑foot unit with adjustable shelves and no freezer compartment. It does not have a freezer.
products.benefit: Picture an office worker needing a reliable fridge for snacks and drinks. The Midea 3.1‑Cubic Foot Compact Refrigerator provides a large 3.1‑cubic‑foot capacity and adjustable shelves, outperforming smaller models. It wins against the Danby by offering more space. The catch: it has no freezer compartment.

products.name: Frigidaire 1.6-Cubic-Foot Compact Fridge
why: Business Insider lists the Frigidaire 1.6‑Cubic‑Foot Compact Fridge as the best compact mini fridge. It offers a 1.6‑cubic‑foot capacity and a sleek look.
products.desc: The Frigidaire 1.6‑Cubic‑Foot Compact Fridge is a 1.6‑cubic‑foot unit with a sleek design and no freezer compartment.
products.benefit: Picture a small apartment where space is limited. The Frigidaire 1.6‑Cubic‑Foot Compact Fridge offers a compact 1.6‑cubic‑foot capacity and a sleek look, making it easier to fit in tight spaces than larger models. It wins against the Midea by being smaller. The catch: it has no freezer compartment.
